title: VP Studio performance sweep
description: Runs a platform of performance models (traffic_gen, at_bus, dram_ctrl, perf_stats) once for every combination of parameter values, and collects metrics from each run's statistics. Run it with "VP Studio: Run Performance Sweep" or vp-run --perf-sweep.

platform.description: The platform file, relative to this file.

sweep.description: Parameters to vary. Every combination is run; the first parameter changes slowest.

param.description: <module>.<parameter>, e.g. cpu.max_outstanding (a module in a subsystem: periph.dma.rate_mbps). One QoS setting of an at_bus: <bus>.masters.<master>.<key>, e.g. mau0.masters.display.min_mbps (keys priority, max_mbps, min_mbps, outstanding, window_ns; 0 for max_mbps or min_mbps turns it off); it changes that setting in the bus's masters text.

metrics.description: Numbers to collect from each run: <section>.<name>.<field>…, section initiators, buses or memories, name the label or module name. For example initiators.cpu.latencyNs.p99, initiators.display.bandwidthMBps, memories.ddr.rowHitRate, memories.ddr.dataBusUtilization, buses.bus.waitNs.cpu.p99, buses.mau0.masters.display.urgentGrants. Empty: every initiator's bandwidth and latency and every memory's bandwidth and row hit rate.

checks.description: Limits for CI: a check fails when the metric is outside min..max in a run it applies to. vp-run exits with 1 when one fails.

where.description: Only runs with these swept values, e.g. {"bus.arbitration": "priority"}.

jobs.description: Runs at the same time (default: half the CPUs).

timeoutSeconds.description: Limit for each run, in seconds of real time (default 600).
